title: Withered
wikitext:
{{distinguish|Wither}} {{status | name = Withered | type = Debuff | description = You are taking increased Chaos Damage. }} '''Withered''' is a [[debuff]] which applies a 6% increased [[chaos damage]] taken on the affected target, stacking up to 15 times. Each stack has its own independent duration (base duration of 2s), which is not refreshed when applying new stacks. ==Mechanics== Due to each stack applying its damage taken debuff independently, {{c|mod|x% increased Effect of Withered}} only reaches breakpoints in multiples of 16.67%, rounded up to the nearest integer. The following table contains an example of the first few breakpoints: {| class="wikitable" |- ! Wither
effect !! Increased

mods.generation_type="10" AND ( mods.stat_text LIKE "%Withered%" ) |stat_text=1 |level=1 }} ===Miscellaneous=== * {{stl|Unholy Might}} is a [[buff]] that grants 25% chance to inflict Withered on hit. * [[Perfect Spider Matriarch]] as a {{il|Raise Spectre}} minion grants the owner 10% increased effect of Withered. * The {{sl|id=AspectOfArakaali}} buff causes the character to inflict Withered on hit, and Withered stacks that the character inflicts are reflected back onto the character. ==Passive Skills== These [[passive skill]]s are related to Withered: ===Base passive skills=== {{Query base "%wither%" }} ==Trivia== The look of Withered was changed in [[version 3.5.3]] from purple orbs (matching {{psl|Withering Presence}}) to the current purple line effect. [[File:Wither skill screenshot.jpg|thumb|200px|The original debuff visual effect for Withered.]] [[File:2nd Screenshot of Withered (from Withering Step) in version 3.20.png|thumb|200px|Debuff visual effect for Withered in [[version 3.20.0]].]] ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.29.0| * The total effect of the Wither debuff is now displayed on the debuff bar of affected targets. }} {{Version history table row|3.21.0| * Added a series of new "{{c|mod|Profane}}" modifiers that can roll on [[Map]]s, [[Logbook]]s, [[Delve]] Biomes, and [[Heist]] Contracts. The rotating orbs have been removed in order to improve performance. }} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| * The debuff applied by the skill [[Wither]] has been assigned the name "Withered", and can be applied by the new support gem [[Withering Touch Support]]. }} {{Version history table end}} {{sister|poe2wiki}} [[Category:Debuffs]]
